c2s.description: Client-to-server (c2s) listener configuration: port, binding address, and TLS options.

c2s.port.description: TCP port on which the server listens for incoming XMPP client connections.

c2s.bind.description: IP address to bind the c2s listener to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '0.0.0.0').

c2s.tls.description: TLS/SSL encryption settings for secure client connections.

c2s.tls.enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for client connections (recommended in production).

c2s.tls.cert_file.description: Path to the server certificate file (PEM format).

c2s.tls.key_file.description: Path to the server private key file (PEM format).

c2s.tls.ciphers.description: Optional colon-separated cipher list (e.g., 'HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5'). Leave empty for defaults.

c2s.tls.verify_peer.description: Whether to verify client certificates (client-cert auth only).

c2s.tls.ca_file.description: Optional CA bundle file for validating client certificates.

authreg.description: Authentication registry backend — how users are verified.

authreg.params.description: List of key-value parameters for the auth driver (e.g., path to passwd file or SQL config).

value.description: Parameter value (e.g., file path or connection string).

storage.description: Storage backend for user data (rosters, vCards, private storage, etc.).

storage.params.description: Storage backend parameters (e.g., database path or connection details).

sm.description: Session manager settings — core routing engine.

sm.id.description: Identifier for the session manager instance.

sm.log.description: Path to the session manager log file.

sm.max_packets.description: Maximum queued packets per session before throttling.

sm.route_localname.description: If true, route packets addressed to local usernames (not FQDNs).

register.enabled.description: Allow users to register accounts via in-band registration (security-sensitive).

register.set_user_password.description: If true, allow users to set their own password during registration.

register.max_users_per_ip.description: Rate-limit: max new accounts allowed per IP per session window.

limits.description: Resource and bandwidth limits for client connections.

limits.max_streams.description: Maximum concurrent client streams per connection (not per user — usually 1).

limits.idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds before disconnecting a client.

limits.read_rate.description: Maximum bytes/second the server will read from a client (0 = unlimited).

limits.write_rate.description: Maximum bytes/second the server will write to a client (0 = unlimited).

debug.description: Debug logging configuration (enable only for troubleshooting).

host.description: Server hostname (FQDN) — must match the domain users log in with (e.g., 'example.com').

dns_srv.description: If true, attempt DNS SRV lookup to locate other servers (for federation).
